notes: Plant wind case P15_tiered_shrub (Tiered shrub) written by scripts/build_plants.py: Four 1566 plant tiers threaded on a 6L bar. Parts picked by constant name from data/categories/parts; frame LDU, -Y up, the case front faces -Z, ground (base top) at y = 0. The wind blows toward +X.

Joints: tier_1: real revolute about [0.0, -1.0, 0.0] through [0.0, -12.0, 0.0] (real: 1566 threaded on the 6L bar (sliding bar hole); turns about the bar (right-hand about up)); tier_2: real revolute about [0.0, -1.0, 0.0] through [0.0, -44.0, 0.0] (real: 1566 threaded on the 6L bar (sliding bar hole); turns about the bar (right-hand about up)); tier_3: real revolute about [0.0, -1.0, 0.0] through [0.0, -76.0, 0.0] (real: 1566 threaded on the 6L bar (sliding bar hole); turns about the bar (right-hand about up)); tier_4: real revolute about [0.0, -1.0, 0.0] through [0.0, -108.0, 0.0] (real: 1566 threaded on the 6L bar (sliding bar hole); turns about the bar (right-hand about up)).
Real LEGO freedoms: tier_1, tier_2, tier_3, tier_4. flex_approx joints (rigid tilt standing in for bending plastic, range <= 0.17 rad): none.

Sign convention by meaning (checked with the evaluator, kinematics.json): tier_1 + = Tier 1 on the bar (real); right-hand about up (-Y): + turns +X toward +Z; tier_2 + = Tier 2 on the bar (real); right-hand about up (-Y): + turns +X toward +Z; tier_3 + = Tier 3 on the bar (real); right-hand about up (-Y): + turns +X toward +Z; tier_4 + = Tier 4 on the bar (real); right-hand about up (-Y): + turns +X toward +Z.

Motion comes from wind clips (scripts/wind_clips.py): a damped-response approximation, not aerodynamics. Ranges are catalog choices narrowed by sampled clearance (scripts/blender/check_plants_clearance.py), not measured stops. Kinematic and transform checks do not prove collision-free or physically feasible motion.
